rows.scientific_claim: The current predictive path is leakage-controlled and temporally evaluated.
rows.thesis_requirement: Temporal split and explicit leakage removal.
rows.article_claim: Claims strict temporal validation and reliable evaluation.
rows.reviewer_concern: Perfect RF/MM-RF and bug_confidence proxy concern.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Canonical audit PASS; Sprint 31 leakage PASS; Sprint 31A provenance defensible with fitted-object limitation.
rows.scientific_gap: Old perfect-score evidence is not rehabilitated; fitted RF/LR objects were not persisted pre-TEST.
rows.required_experiment: For every new protocol, predeclare schemas, temporal cutoffs, label provenance, denylist, and persist fitted states before evaluation.
rows.expected_evidence: Signed validity contract, feature lineage, zero proxy overlap, persisted estimator digests.
rows.notes: Historical approximately 1.0 RF/MM-RF results are SUPERSEDED, not valid evidence.

rows.scientific_claim: Leakage-safe unimodal CODE, PROCESS, and TEXT baselines exist.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 25 VALIDATION: CODE RF .691/.161; PROCESS RF .480/.061; TEXT LR .698/.140 ROC/AP.
rows.scientific_gap: Only one development split; PROCESS is a minimal ancestor-only representation and lacks accepted generalization evidence.
rows.required_experiment: Re-evaluate all three frozen/predeclared modality representations in multiple temporal origins and new evaluation boundaries.
rows.expected_evidence: Fold/period-level ROC-AUC, AP, calibration and operational metrics with uncertainty.
rows.notes: Existing numbers are development evidence only.

rows.scientific_claim: All CODE+PROCESS, CODE+TEXT, PROCESS+TEXT combinations have been compared.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 26 evaluated all three fixed equal-weight combinations on VALIDATION; CODE+TEXT was strongest.
rows.scientific_gap: Equal-weight VALIDATION comparisons exist, but no independent accepted evaluation across temporal origins.
rows.required_experiment: Predeclared bimodal comparison under identical temporal folds and representations.
rows.expected_evidence: Paired temporal-fold effects and intervals for every bimodal versus constituent unimodals.

rows.scientific_claim: A true leakage-safe CODE+PROCESS+TEXT model improves prediction.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 26 full candidate ROC/AP .731/.186 versus CODE+TEXT .746/.193 on VALIDATION.
rows.scientific_gap: A full equal-weight candidate exists only on development VALIDATION and underperformed CODE+TEXT; no accepted full-model claim.
rows.required_experiment: Evaluate predeclared full three-modality candidate without using Sprint 31 TEST; allow neutral/negative conclusion.
rows.expected_evidence: Temporal paired effects showing benefit, neutrality, or harm with uncertainty.
rows.notes: Current primary predictor is bimodal, not the claimed full MMSDP-XAI.

rows.scientific_claim: Fixed probability-level late fusion benefits prediction.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 27 paired VALIDATION bootstrap favored CODE+TEXT; Sprint 31 sealed only the selected model.
rows.scientific_gap: CODE+TEXT benefit is supported on development data and one sealed point estimate, but TEST cannot be reused for a comparative claim.
rows.required_experiment: Compare fixed fusion against constituents on new temporal evaluation boundaries.
rows.expected_evidence: Paired temporal effects and corrected inference across predeclared comparisons.

rows.scientific_claim: Learned late fusion/stacking is superior or necessary.
rows.thesis_requirement: Metamodel LR is the planned default.
rows.article_claim: Claims meta-learning and both early/late fusion inconsistently.
rows.reviewer_concern: Do not conflate fixed fusion and stacking.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Current executed fusion is fixed and unlearned; stacking code existence is not experimental evidence.
rows.scientific_gap: Repository has stacking implementation/tests, but no leakage-safe executed scientific comparison for the current dataset.
rows.required_experiment: Only if retained as a thesis claim: nested temporal OOF stacking, compared with fixed fusion; otherwise narrow the claim.
rows.expected_evidence: Out-of-time meta-features, no in-fold predictions, paired effects versus fixed fusion.
rows.notes: Ordinary shuffled stacking folds are forbidden.

rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 26 PROCESS additions degraded both ROC-AUC and AP; Sprint 27 supports CODE+TEXT only.
rows.scientific_gap: CODE and TEXT complementarity is development-supported; PROCESS contribution is explicitly unsupported under its current representation.
rows.required_experiment: Leave-one-modality-out plus constituent comparisons across temporal origins; feature-group ablation only for interpretable, predeclared groups.
rows.expected_evidence: Incremental paired effect sizes and uncertainty; honest rejection if PROCESS adds no value.

rows.article_claim: Specifies Platt, but abstract claims generic calibration.
rows.current_repository_evidence: VALIDATION compared all three; Sprint 31 isotonic reduced Brier .03991→.03702 and ECE .05896→.02394, with lower ROC/AP.
rows.scientific_gap: Supported only for frozen CODE+TEXT predictor on one TEST period; article/thesis specify Platt while isotonic was selected.
rows.required_experiment: In new protocols compare uncalibrated, Platt, isotonic using temporal/nested calibration boundaries and reliability diagrams.
rows.expected_evidence: Brier, ECE with sensitivity to binning, reliability plots, ROC-AUC/AP diagnostics and paired uncertainty.

rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 27 seed and VALIDATION bootstrap stability; Sprint 31 one temporal TEST.
rows.scientific_gap: Seed/training-fraction/bootstrap/project subgroup evidence is development-only and is not repeated temporal evaluation.
rows.required_experiment: Rolling-origin or blocked temporal evaluation with multiple chronological holdouts; no random k-fold.
rows.expected_evidence: Period-level distributions, drift/prevalence reporting, confidence intervals.

rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 27 paired bootstrap is development evidence, explicitly not population inference.
rows.scientific_gap: No final multi-period/project inferential design; Wilcoxon over individual prediction rows would violate the unit-of-analysis logic.
rows.required_experiment: Paired bootstrap within holdout for metric differences; Wilcoxon plus Cliff's delta only across independent temporal/project units when enough units exist; Holm correction.
rows.expected_evidence: 95% CIs, paired effects, corrected p-values when valid, effect sizes.

rows.scientific_claim: The contribution is insensitive to classifier family.
rows.thesis_requirement: Plans XGBoost/LSTM/CodeBERT, inconsistent with executed simple models.
rows.reviewer_concern: Framework effect should not be one-classifier artifact.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 25 executed LR/RF per modality on VALIDATION.
rows.scientific_gap: LR/RF candidates exist, but modality representation and classifier are partly confounded; no compact full-framework sensitivity analysis.
rows.required_experiment: Use LR as transparent linear baseline, RF as nonlinear baseline, and one gradient-boosted tree family if dependency/provenance permits; avoid gratuitous SVM/deep models.
rows.expected_evidence: Same temporal folds and representations, paired sensitivity results, compute budget/provenance.

rows.current_repository_evidence: One JIT-Defects4J temporal boundary; Qt pipeline artifacts are not accepted external predictive evidence.
rows.scientific_gap: JIT-Defects4J contains 21 projects but one benchmark construction; Qt artifacts are incomplete/non-equivalent and no independent compatible evaluation exists.
rows.required_experiment: Validate on a compatible commit-level, temporally ordered dataset with construct-equivalent labels/modalities; optionally leave-project-out/cross-project as a separate question.
rows.expected_evidence: Dataset compatibility contract, temporal results, transportability limitations.
rows.notes: PROMISE module-level datasets are not construct-compatible by default.

rows.scientific_claim: Predictions are explainable and explanations are stable/useful.
rows.article_claim: Claims explanations already generated and useful.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Explainability modules and tests exist; no accepted SHAP/LIME/counterfactual execution for frozen model.
rows.scientific_gap: XAI infrastructure/tests are not model explanation evidence; current accepted predictor has no executed XAI study.
rows.required_experiment: After predictive acceptance, run global/local explanation fidelity and stability analyses; optional stakeholder evaluation; label outputs predictive associations, never causes.
rows.expected_evidence: Method/model compatibility, stability under resampling, fidelity, representative local cases and limitations.

rows.scientific_claim: The model improves operational defect-risk prioritization.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 31 intentionally reports probability-only metrics; threshold undefined.
rows.scientific_gap: No frozen threshold or effort/budget-aware metric; CODE features do not presently provide a validated inspection-cost denominator.
rows.required_experiment: Predeclare Recall@K and Precision@K; add AUCEC/Popt only if changed lines/files are a defensible effort proxy.
rows.expected_evidence: Budget curves and uncertainty under realistic inspection budgets.

rows.scientific_claim: The sealed Sprint 31 TEST can guide future model development.
rows.current_repository_evidence: Sprint 31 one-shot state and Sprint 31A integrity audit.
rows.scientific_gap: R8/R9 prohibit any reuse for selection or adaptation.
rows.required_experiment: Create new chronological development/evaluation boundaries from untouched later periods or independent compatible datasets; keep Sprint 31 historical only.
rows.expected_evidence: New predeclared boundaries and explicit exclusion of Sprint 31 scores from decisions.
rows.notes: test_access_required is false for development; any future final test must be new.
